    Product Details
    Pampers Premium Care Size 1 Disposable Nappies offer gentle protection and dryness for your baby. They are specifically designed for babies weighing 2-5kg. Key features include 10 million breathable micropores that allow air to flow freely to the baby's skin, ensuring ultra skin comfort. The nappies incorporate an ultra-absorb core that locks wetness away, keeping the baby's skin dry, along with a system for absorbing runny messes. A wetness indicator clearly signals when a nappy change is needed. The cotton-like softness gently wraps the baby's skin in ultimate comfort.
